repos.name: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
repos.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Factory Droid, and Pi. 42 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive, high-quality collection of editorial-grade diagrams for technical documentation and AI-assisted workflows.
bullets: Built using pure, self-contained HTML and SVG for maximum portability and performance.
Provides 42 distinct diagram types designed specifically for technical contexts like AI agents and software architecture.
Serves as a clean, professional alternative to automated diagramming tools that often produce cluttered output.
Ideal for developers and technical writers creating documentation for LLM-based systems and complex infrastructure.

repos.name: storytold/vectorcraft
repos.description: An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Illustrator, built in pure Rust.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Illustrator built entirely in Rust.
bullets: Developed in Rust, leveraging memory safety and high-concurrency performance for complex vector operations.
Focuses on a modular, clean-room architecture to provide a modern, open-source alternative to legacy design software.
Targets professional design workflows requiring precise control over vector paths and assets.
Represents a significant infrastructure project in the creative tooling space, emphasizing native performance.

repos.name: storytold/filmcraft
repos.description: An open-source, clean-room reimplementation of Adobe Premiere Pro built in pure Rust.
repos.one_liner: An open-source, high-performance reimplementation of professional video editing software built in Rust.
bullets: Utilizes Rust's low-level control to handle high-bandwidth video processing and non-linear editing tasks.
Designed as a clean-room implementation to ensure a modern, efficient codebase free from legacy bloat.
Provides a robust foundation for building custom media processing pipelines and automated video generation tools.
Relevant for developers building AI-driven video synthesis or automated content creation infrastructure.

repos.name: joshuaswarren/omarchy-apple-dev
repos.description: Build and deploy iOS SwiftUI apps from Omarchy Linux on Apple Silicon, no Xcode required
repos.one_liner: A specialized toolset for building and deploying iOS SwiftUI applications directly from Linux environments.
bullets: Enables cross-platform development workflows by bypassing the requirement for a native Xcode environment.
Leverages Apple Silicon capabilities to bridge the gap between Linux-based dev environments and iOS deployment.
Streamlines the CI/CD pipeline for mobile developers by reducing dependency on proprietary macOS-only tooling.
Highly applicable for infrastructure engineers looking to automate mobile app builds in containerized or Linux-based environments.

repos.name: DuarteSantos8/openGym
repos.description: Self-hosted gym & body-weight tracker — plan routines, log workouts (supersets, warm-ups, cardio), see which muscles are trained, fatigued or detrained, import from FitNotes/Strong/Hevy, passkey login. Your data, your server.
repos.one_liner: A self-hosted, privacy-focused fitness tracking platform with advanced analytics for workout optimization.
bullets: Features a robust data-logging engine for tracking supersets, warm-ups, and muscle fatigue metrics.
Includes sophisticated analytics to visualize muscle training load and detraining cycles.
Supports data portability through imports from major fitness apps like FitNotes and Strong.
Uses modern security standards like passkey authentication, making it a model for secure, self-hosted personal data infrastructure.
